sources_considered.why: Independent survey fielded in November 2024; measures LLM use specifically and reports sampling and intensity limitations.
Read to verify the survey report's publication date of July 22, 2025.
Contemporaneous report reproduces OpenAI's dated usage announcement. Used as news reporting of company figures because a directly readable primary announcement was not obtained.
Its August 2024 observation falls outside the target quarter and covers generative AI more broadly.
The featured 2025 usage observation cannot establish late-2024 adoption.

evidence_items.locator: Incidence of LLM use — Population level estimates

receipt.public_excerpt: 40% of US adults have tried ChatGPT specifically.

evidence_items.explanation: The November survey estimated broad public participation, with search, explanation and writing leading uses. Material qualifications in this same source are possible online-panel selection bias and light usage: its conservative weekly-use estimate was about 29%, and most adults did not use LLMs in a typical week.

receipt.public_excerpt: ChatGPT now has 300 million weekly active users

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's reported weekly audience corroborates substantial recurring use during the target quarter. It is a company-reported count, not an independently audited population measure.

unresolved_gaps: No separate representative adoption measure for reasoning models was established.
The evidence does not establish essentiality, intensive daily use, or smartphone-like economic importance.
